findings.evidence_sql: SELECT j."JRNL_NO", SUM(j."DR_AMT") AS dr, SUM(j."CR_AMT") AS cr FROM public."GLJRNL" j WHERE j."JRNL_NO"=1406 GROUP BY j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ABS(SUM(j."DR_AMT")-SUM(j."CR_AMT"))>0.001
findings.summary: Journal 1406 (SRC_CD=AP, PRD_ID=1) is out of balance: DR 1573.46 vs CR 1537.46, a 36.00 difference. It is the only unbalanced journal in GLJRNL.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM public."APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (602,801)
findings.summary: Vendor invoice V0020-75786-602 is entered twice (INV_ID 602 and 801) with the same vendor, amount 9478.36 and date 20241108; 801's INV_NO has a leading space. Both have separate journals (2005 and 2488). Invoice 801 is open while 602 is paid.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS ap_credit FROM public."APINVH" i JOIN public."GLJRNH" j ON j."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" JOIN public."GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=j."JRNL_NO" AND TRIM(l."ACCT_CD")='2000' WHERE i."INV_ID"=671 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", j."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."CR_AMT")::numeric,2)<>ROUND(i."INV_AMT"::numeric,2)
findings.summary: Invoice 671 (3792.24) is posted to AP control account 2000 for 3801.24 in its journal 2114, a 9.00 overstatement versus the subledger.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(p."PAY_AMT") AS paid, i."STAT_CD" FROM public."APINVH" i LEFT JOIN public."APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."INV_ID"=165 GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD"
findings.summary: Invoice 165 is flagged paid (P) but its payments total 1374.76 against an invoice amount of 1374.77, a 0.01 shortfall. Settlement-to-document mismatch, not a closed-period issue.
